thread_title: Is this worthy of a registered cultivar?  Vote here!

posts.body_html:
Mike,

  It's so hard to judge these plants by photos alone. For the longest time I couldn't figure out why everyone gushed over S. × 'Reptilian Rose'. I thought it was over rated. Then I actually got one and was immediately smitten. I wonder if that's what's going on here. You have the good fortune of being with this plant in person and it strikes your fancy. None of us have yet had the opportunity to experience this beauty in person to really let it have a chance to speak to us.
